source.title: Elemental Distress
source.description:
Listen, <name>. The corruption I spoke of before goes beyond Baron Aquanis. I've been sensing a certain unease within the elemental world for some time. I fear something is gravely wrong, and the corruption of Baron Aquanis only furthers my suspicions.

Find more of those elementals who are suffering: here in Ashenvale, and in the nearby Stonetalon Mountains. Bring me motes of their essence. Perhaps I can analyze them, and begin to understand the nature of their rage.
source.objective: Collect motes of elemental rage, and bring them to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.
source.progress: The elementals suffer greatly, <name>. I must know why.
source.completion: Thank you, <name>. Hopefully these will provide some answers.
